Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in understanding the density of the materials. The Planner incorrectly assumed that the density of bulk packed iron nails is lower (~0.8 g/cm³) than the density of feathers (~1.3 g/cm³). In reality, iron nails are significantly denser than feathers, and their density is much higher, typically around 7.8 g/cm³. This miscalculation led the Planner to conclude that the mass of feathers is greater, which is incorrect. The correct comparison is that the mass of the feathers is less than the mass of the nails, as indicated by the correct answer, B.
